title: Patagonia off the beaten path

budget.covers: food, fuel, campgrounds, park fees, ferries (not flights or the car)

guided_trips: avoid (mention only really worthwhile ones, marked optional)

overnight_trips.note: optional; tent carried in, one night, out the next day

arrival_note: Jan 26: depart Zagreb. Jan 27: land in Santiago and fly on to Balmaceda the same day. Feb 21: fly out of Balmaceda (a morning or midday flight), and fly home on Feb 22.
lede: Alternative plans for Jan 27 – Feb 21 2027 from Balmaceda that favour quiet, less-visited valleys and parks over the famous highlights, with up to two optional one-night tent trips. Most plans avoid the busiest places entirely; one mixes in a few highlights for comparison, and the plans differ in how much long gravel driving they accept.

preferences.crowds: prefer places that are not touristy; plans that avoid the famous highlights entirely (El Chaltén/Fitz Roy, Cerro Castillo main trail, Capillas de Mármol, Laguna San Rafael tours), plus exactly one plan that mixes a few highlights in
preferences.long_gravel_drives: at least one plan with long gravel drives (e.g. Paso Roballos, Lago Verde, Raúl Marín Balmaceda back roads) and at least one plan without them
preferences.less_marked_trails: ok (GPS navigation, still within max_sac and easy cross-country only)
preferences.remote_wild_camping: ok (car nights away from campgrounds and towns)
preferences.private_land: avoid hikes that need landowner permission
